items.longBusinessSummary: BitFuFu Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital asset mining solutions in North America, Asia, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. The company offers cloud-mining and miner hosting services to institutional customers and individual digital asset enthusiasts. It also provides Bitcoin self-mining, mining machine hosting, and other services. In addition, the company leases and sells mining equipment. BitFuFu Inc. is headquartered in Singapore.

Title: BitFuFu September Bitcoin Output Slips to 167 BTC, Holdings Edge Up to 1,388
Author: Editorial Staff   Wed, October 14, 2026 at 12:01 AM GMT+2 2 min read
Published: 2026-10-13T22:01:00+00:00
=== BODY ===
BitFuFu (NASDAQ: $FUFU) mined 167 bitcoin in September, 4% fewer than in August, and warned of a "material risk" that its proposed acquisition of an Ethiopian mining facility may not close, the Singapore-based miner said late Tuesday.
Total production included 98 Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) from self-mining, up from 88 in August, and 69 from cloud mining, down from 86. Daily output held steady at 5.6 bitcoin. The company's holdings rose by 15 bitcoin to 1,388 as of Sept. 30.
Hashrate under management slipped to 19.4 EH/s from 20.6 EH/s. Self-owned hashrate was unchanged at 3.8 EH/s, while capacity from third-party suppliers and hosting customers fell to 15.6 EH/s from 16.8 EH/s. Power capacity under management declined to 324 megawatts from 344 megawatts. Average fleet efficiency held at 16.7 joules per terahash.

Coinbase Targets Banks As Institutional Crypto Adoption Grows
60 Percent of Community Banks See Stablecoins as a Threat to Deposits, Lending
Crypto Heavyweights Back OKX at $25B Valuation
The more consequential disclosure concerned Ethiopia. Under an agreement signed in October 2024, BitFuFu is seeking to acquire a majority stake in an Ethiopian company that operates an 80-megawatt mining facility. The deal has not closed, and not all of its conditions have been met or waived. BitFuFu has paid the sellers $4.1 million and deployed about 13,700 Bitmain Antminer S19 machines at the site, representing roughly 1.57 EH/s and a net book value of $1.74 million.
The company said it recently learned that the target is in a contractual dispute with its power supplier, to which BitFuFu is not a party. On Sept. 28, the supplier warned it would seize the target's collateralized equipment and assets if payment was not made within 10 days. To the company's knowledge, the disputed amounts remain unpaid.
BitFuFu said it is evaluating its options, including terminating the agreement, pursuing arbitration against the sellers, and recovering its payments and machines. The outcome remains uncertain, it noted.
CEO Leo Lu sought to limit the concern, characterizing the investment as a small share of the company's assets. He said local power curtailment at the facility is already reflected in previously reported monthly results, and that he expects limited further impact on production. The company added that it could reallocate existing resources if the machines' operating environment changes.
Shares of BitFuFu (NASDAQ: FUFU) are trading at $1.34.

Title: BitFuFu September Bitcoin Production Falls Sequentially
Author: MT Newswires   Tue, October 13, 2026 at 11:48 PM GMT+2
Published: 2026-10-13T21:48:41+00:00
=== BODY ===
BitFuFu (FUFU) produced 167 bitcoins in September, compared with 174 bitcoins produced in August, the company said late Tuesday.The company said it held 1,388 bitcoins in September, compared with 1,373 bitcoins in August. Also, BitFuFu said it recently become aware that an Ethiopian company, which is under an acquisition agreement with company, is involved in a contractual dispute with its electric power supplier in Ethiopia.The company said it will continue to monitor the Ethiopia situation to protect the security of its existing investments and currently assessing its contractual rights and available remedies, including potential termination of the agreement.
